Presidential Gubernatorial Suspected thugs
The police have confirmed the arrest of suspected thugs who allegedly attacked the campaign convoy of the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) in the Bichi Local Government Area of Kano State.
The police spokesperson in the state, Abdullahi Kiyawa, said normalcy has been restored in the area following “a violent clash between supporters of the All Progressives Congress (APC) and the NDC that left five people injured and 13 vehicles vandalised.
The police said the incident occurred at about 4:45 p.m. on Sunday in Bichi township, resulting in widespread destruction of campaign banners and billboards.
Mr Kiyawa also confirmed that police operatives were swiftly deployed to the scene upon receiving distress reports, bringing the situation under control and arresting eight suspects.
According to Mr Kiyawa, the five injured victims were rushed to the hospital, where they are currently receiving medical treatment.
“Security operatives also recovered several dangerous weapons and illicit substances as exhibits at the scene, including a locally fabricated weapon (Gariyo), two cutlasses, two hard sticks, a bottle of chemical solution, and a substance locally known as “Suck and Die.”
“Reacting to the incident, the Kano State Commissioner of Police strongly condemned the resort to violence and the destruction of campaign materials, warning that the Command would not tolerate any act capable of breaching public peace before, during, or after the political season.

“Political activities must be conducted peacefully and in accordance with the law. No individual or group is above the law,” the police commissioner warned.
The police spokesperson added that the eight suspects have been transferred to the State Criminal Investigation Department (SCID) in Bompai for a discreet investigation and will be charged in court after the inquiries conclude.
